thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] PagerDuty page fired for service: autoscaler.queue-depth-high (PD INCIDENT: #INC-4728)

pagerduty: page fired -> responders: sara_oncall, backup_oncall_jay. escalation policy: oncall-rotation.

SARA_ONCALL: taking initial triage - seeing sustained queue depth rise over last 6m, autoscaler not adding nodes.

MATT? (mike_eng): saw a few hints in metrics earlier, could be node launch backlog due to spot pool exhaustion.

SARA_ONCALL: @mike_eng can you confirm if provisioning API is returning errors? I can try manual surge if needed.

MIKE_ENG: checking kube-provisioner logs now. quick grep: `kubectl logs provisioner-3 -n infra | tail -n 200` shows repeated `rate limit exceeded` and `quota denied` to cloud provider.

ANITA_SRE: i'm seeing high pending pods where kvcache warmup jobs are stuck waiting for nodes: `pending=612` on the inference-queue.

LEO_INFRA: Cloud shows spot capacity 0 in us-west-2 for g5 class for the past 7m. Fallback pool (on-demand) has capacity but autoscaler config has minSpotOnly=true for this pool.

SARA_ONCALL: oh — that config explains it. we didn't have an on-demand fallback enabled. can we flip to allow on-demand burst?

EVA_PROD: customer impact: we’re seeing 40% of requests queued >5s, some >30s. No 5xx spike yet but latency SLO trending to breach. A handful of premium customers reported timeouts.

SARA_ONCALL: paging playbook step 1: try manual scale to bring up on-demand nodes; step 2: enable fallback pool; step 3: route traffic to dedicated capacity if degradation continues.

BACKUP_ONCALL_JAY: i'll take backup while sara runs manual steps. Jay taking over channel.

SARA_ONCALL: running manual scale: `./scripts/provision.sh --pool on-demand --count 6`

MIKE_ENG: provisioning command returned `ACK: starting instances` but then immediate errors: `InsufficientInstanceCapacity` appears.

ANITA_SRE: Workaround: reduce replica requests per node via quick patch to autoscaler config so smaller VMs fit available capacity. Can we apply temporary override?

LEO_INFRA: we can patch to allow smaller instance types and enable ephemeral fallback. Pushing config now: `kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --patch '{"spec":{"enableFallback":true,"allowedTypes":["g4dn.xlarge","g4dn.2xlarge"]}}'`

MIKE_ENG: hit apply. now restarting autoscaler pods to pick up config: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/autoscaler -n infra`

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout of autoscaler started by mike_eng. watch: https://deploys.redwood.io/autoscaler/rollouts/1972

SARA_ONCALL: monitoring queue depth...

EVA_PROD: still high but dropping. queue depth peaked at 8k, now trending down to 2.1k after 3m. request latency 95th from 12s -> 6s. partial relief but still unstable.

MIKE_ENG: noticed many kvcache warmup jobs failing with `connection refused` to shard orchestrator. opening a side thread to check orchestrator health.

ANITA_SRE: if orchestrator is flapping, caches won't warm and we'll keep high per-request generation times. can we fail traffic to model-variant-lowmem as temporary fallback?

SARA_ONCALL: Gateway routing change could help — shifting 20% to variant-lowmem to reduce per-instance memory warmup. Who can patch route?

MIKE_ENG: I can apply a canary route: `redwood ctl route set inference --split 80/20 --variant default/lowmem` — applying now.

incident-bot: route-bot: route change applied by mike_eng.

EVA_PROD: early telemetry shows those 20% requests have ~30% lower latency. overall 95th now ~4.2s. still not back to normal but much better. customers still seeing intermittent tail spikes.

BACKUP_ONCALL_JAY: I'm going to start the PD ack rotation. Sara, want to hand over primary?

SARA_ONCALL: handing to Jay in 10m. i'll stay as advisor. main ask: validate autoscaler metrics stabilize and no more `InsufficientInstanceCapacity`.

MIKE_ENG: confirmed autoscaler logs look healthy post-restart. some throttling to cloud API still happening but backoff retries succeeding.

LEO_INFRA: Cloud quota team confirmed temporary spot pool blip; they pushed capacity 12m ago. we should be ok once existing pending pods are scheduled.

EVA_PROD: customer impact summary for incident: ~3% error-rate equivalent (timeouts) during peak 7m, affecting mainly high-concurrency jobs. estimated affected customers: 8 orgs, 2 of them on premium had degraded experience.

SARA_ONCALL: remediation summary: enabled fallback to on-demand / smaller instance types, restarted autoscaler to pick up config, applied 20% route split to lowmem variant, manual provision attempts.

ANITA_SRE: next steps: add automated fallback in autoscaler policy so it can auto-switch to on-demand under spot shortage, add synthetic warmup jobs during low traffic, and add tighter alerting on spot pool capacity trending.

MIKE_ENG: filing follow-up ticket: INF-7834 — Autoscaler: implement auto-fallback + smaller-instance pool. will include runbook changes.

SARA_ONCALL: closing notes: PD incident #INC-4728 acknowledged and handled, escalation not required to paging escalation policy. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident closed for pagerduty #INC-4728 (status: mitigated)

BACKUP_ONCALL_JAY: I'm monitoring for next 30m, will alert if any regressions.

EVA_PROD: adding a brief customer-facing status note for operations team to review.

SARA_ONCALL: thanks everyone. good work coordinating.
